title: Equality of circuit evaluations
statement: Let $C_n$ and $D_n$ be tree circuits on $n$ inputs for each natural number $n$. Suppose that for every Boolean list $w$, the circuits $C_{|w|}$ and $D_{|w|}$ have the same truth value under the assignment given by the entries of $w$. Then for every natural number $n$ and every Boolean assignment to $n$ inputs, $C_n$ and $D_n$ have the same truth value.
hypotheses_covered: Families $C_n,D_n$ of tree circuits indexed by natural numbers
For every Boolean list $w$, evaluations of $C_{|w|}$ and $D_{|w|}$ agree under the assignment of entries of $w$
